name: Hearts
description: Four-player Hearts: follow suit, hearts cannot be led until broken, every heart costs a point and the queen of spades thirteen; shooting the moon included.

target.description: The game ends when a player reaches this score.

brief.situation: Four players play Hearts, a trick-taking game where points are bad: the lowest score wins.
brief.rules: Each hand all 52 cards are dealt, 13 each. The holder of the 2 of clubs leads it to the first trick. Every player in turn plays one card: you must follow the suit that was led if you can; if you cannot, play anything. The highest card of the suit led wins the trick (aces high, no trumps) and its winner leads the next one. You may not lead a heart until a heart has been played (hearts are broken), unless you hold only hearts. After 13 tricks every heart you took scores 1 point and the queen of spades 13. Taking all 26 points (shooting the moon) scores 0 for you and 26 for everyone else. The game ends after {$inputs.hands} hands or when someone reaches {$inputs.target}.

roles.player: Take as few points as possible: avoid winning tricks that hold hearts or the queen of spades, and get rid of dangerous high cards when you cannot follow suit.

leader.description: Player who leads the current trick.

legal.expr: ($world.lead_suit != '' and $card in $follow_suit($hand($who), $world.lead_suit)) or ($world.lead_suit == '' and ($world.trick > 0 or $card.id == '2C') and ($card.suit != hearts or $world.hearts_broken or $all($hand($who), $it.suit == hearts)))
legal.description: Whether `who` may play `card` to the current trick.

stages.name: trick
stages.brief: Trick {$world.trick + 1} of 13. {$'Led: ' + $world.lead_suit + '.' if $world.lead_suit != '' else 'You lead.'} Hearts are {$'broken' if $world.hearts_broken else 'not broken yet'}.

on_idle.say: {$actor.name} ran out of time and plays {$card.name}.

on_exit.say: {$taker.name} takes the trick ({$card_names($zone(trick))}) with {$winning.name}{$': ' + $text($taken) + ' points' if $taken > 0 else ''}.

do.say: Hand {$world.hand}: the cards are dealt; {$entity($world.leader).name} holds the 2 of clubs and leads.

End of hand {$world.hand}{$': ' + $moon.name + ' shot the moon' if $moon != null else ''}. Points this hand: {$join($map(player, $it.name + ' ' + $text($it.points)), ', ')}. Scores: {$join($map(player, $it.name + ' ' + $text($it.score)), ', ')}.

scores.title: Scores
scores.show: {name}: {score} ({points} this hand, {tricks} tricks){$' · leads' if $it.id == $world.leader else ''}

winner.description: Lowest score (the first seat wins ties).
